hypothesis: The dense current-pitch-group oracle has goal-scale control headroom, while the deployable selector remains the bottleneck. Completed-season target-free batter TrackMan approach profiles can improve which coarse group a pitcher selects against a specific batter, even though those profiles did not improve the unconditional exact-C control model.

relationship_to_prior_work.dense_pitchtype_moe: Keeps its counter-derived historical group labels, selector model, pitch-group experts and row-local pitchmix state unchanged.
relationship_to_prior_work.batter_trackman_rich: Reuses the already audited 42 target-free, strict-cutoff batter profile features; the failed direct-control use is not retuned.
relationship_to_prior_work.new_structure: The 42 batter TrackMan columns are visible only to the coarse pitch selector and are explicitly removed from every control-outcome expert.

locked_model.control_experts: Exact parent feature view and fixed exact-C 500-tree outcome parameters; all e101/e102/e103 columns excluded.
locked_model.routing: Candidate affects R only; F remains exact-C parent.

source_selection.ranking: maximize minimum full gain, then minimum R gain, then mean full gain, then smaller gamma
source_selection.on_fail: Close this selector-only batter axis without reading 2022+ labels.
source_selection.on_pass: Freeze gamma and every model/feature parameter before 2022 and 2023 development.
